fields.System.Title: Campus events portal
fields.System.Description: A single page where students can discover, search and register for campus events.

fields.System.Title: View upcoming events
fields.System.Description: As a student, I want to see a list of upcoming campus events so that I can decide what to attend.
fields.Microsoft.VSTS.Common.AcceptanceCriteria:
1. The home page lists every upcoming event, sorted by date and time.
  2. Each event shows its title, date and time, location, description and seats left.
  3. A fully booked event is labelled Full.

comments.author: Workshop Developer
comments.text: Implemented and merged. Baseline for the workshop.

fields.System.Title: Search events by keyword
fields.System.Description: As a student, I want to search events by keyword so that I can quickly find events on topics I care about.
fields.Microsoft.VSTS.Common.AcceptanceCriteria:
1. API: GET /api/events?q=<keyword> returns only events whose title or description contains the keyword, case-insensitive. Leading and trailing whitespace in the keyword is ignored.
  2. API: when q is missing or blank, all events are returned.
  3. UI: the home page has a search box labelled Search events and a Search button. Submitting a keyword shows only matching events.
  4. UI: when nothing matches, the page shows the message No events match your search.
  5. UI: clearing the search box and submitting shows all events again.

comments.author: Product Owner
comments.text: Search title and description only. Searching by tags or location is out of scope for this sprint.

comments.author: QA Lead
comments.text: Please cover the no-results message and the whitespace case in both unit and E2E tests.

fields.System.Title: Register for an event with a capacity limit
fields.System.Description: As a student, I want to register for an event so that my seat is reserved.
fields.Microsoft.VSTS.Common.AcceptanceCriteria:
1. API: POST /api/events/:id/register with JSON { name, email } returns 201 and { eventId, name, seatsRemaining }, and reduces seats remaining by one.
  2. API: returns 409 with { error: "Event is full" } when no seats remain.
  3. API: returns 400 with { error: "A valid name and email are required" } when name is blank or email is invalid.
  4. API: returns 404 for an unknown event.
  5. UI: each event that is not full has a Register button that opens a form for name and email; on success the page shows You're registered! and the seats-left count updates.
  6. UI: full events show no Register button.

comments.author: Product Owner
comments.text: Registrations can stay in memory for now; persistence is a later story.

fields.System.Title: Event date and time shown in raw format
fields.Microsoft.VSTS.TCM.ReproSteps:
1. Open the home page.
  2. Look at the date line of Intro to Machine Learning.

Actual: 2026-10-12 18:00

Expected: Mon, Oct 12, 2026 · 6:00 PM
fields.System.Description: Dates and times are displayed exactly as stored, which is hard to read.
fields.Microsoft.VSTS.Common.AcceptanceCriteria:
1. Dates display as Ddd, Mmm D, YYYY and times as 12-hour h:mm AM/PM, joined by · . Example: Mon, Oct 12, 2026 · 6:00 PM.
  2. Midnight shows as 12:00 AM and noon as 12:00 PM.
  3. The formatting is a pure function with unit tests (regression tests), and does not depend on the computer's time zone.

comments.author: QA Lead
comments.text: Found during exploratory testing on Chrome. Please add a regression test for 00:00 and 12:00.
